own_solution.law: Lightly damped oscillator: envelope A(t) = A0 exp(-b t / (2m)); t = (2m/b) ln(1/0.2)
assumptions: Frictionless track, ideal spring, negligible air resistance (stated)

notes: t = 2*0.5*ln5/0.2 = 1.609438/0.2 = 8.0472 s. With an extra 0.19 kg/s damper on the block, b = 0.39 kg/s and t = 1.609438/0.39 = 4.1268 s. Spring constant 60 N/m enters omega_d = sqrt(k/m - (b/2m)^2) but not the envelope decay rate b/(2m), so it cancels (C); it could equally be described as K with regime b < 2 sqrt(k m) = 10.95 kg/s, satisfied with margin (and for b = 0.39). Released from rest gives an envelope A0 sqrt(1 + (gamma/omega)^2) e^{-gamma t}, whose ratio to its initial value is still e^{-gamma t}. TF11F/T9920 both state 60 N/m. T7E76 and TB3BF carry no number ('a small value'); the others state 0.19 kg/s.
